scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,api,docs --prefix-colors blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:docs"
scripts.prod: npm run build:web && rm -rf apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/public && cp -r apps/web/public apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/public && cp -r apps/web/.next/static apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static && npm run build:docs && concurrently --names web,api,docs --prefix-colors blue,green,yellow "node --env-file=apps/web/.env.local apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/server.js" "NODE_ENV=production npm run start --workspace=@opendocs/api" "npm run serve --workspace=@opendocs/docs"
